title: Design System Fonts Dataset
description: Font families used by public design systems (declared in the npm packages of 143 design systems at pinned versions), and open-licence font families from Google Fonts and original foundry repositories, Inter included. For each family: licence code and class, commercial status, provider, source repository and commit, variable-font status and axes, OpenType features for tabular, lining, oldstyle and zero figures and ligatures, Serbian Cyrillic and Latin coverage, and the SHA-256 of the measured file. Metadata and facts only; no font files are redistributed. Every value is reproducible with the scripts in the release.
